entities.name: Liont
entities.description: Human smith and former werewolf of Kessig on Innistrad, who killed his family and was killed by Avacyn.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angel who answered Liont's call and killed him.

entities.name: Cursemute
entities.description: Event during which Liont's werewolf nature was cured.

events.summary: During the Cursemute Liont was cured of his werewolf nature.
events.quote: Liont’s werewolf nature was completely cured

events.summary: When the Cursemute ended he turned into a werewolf and killed his whole family.
events.quote: he uncontrollably turned into a werewolf and killed his whole family

events.summary: Liont called for Avacyn in despair, and she killed him with a blast from her spear.
events.quote: In answer to his prayer, she shot a blast of white light from her spear, killing him.

relations.quote: she shot a blast of white light from her spear, killing him
